translation_notes: every term construction becomes an island in ordinary Python operand position: URIRef("urn:test:current") -> <urn:test:current>, RDF.type -> rdf:type, ex.instance1 -> ex:instance1 inside tuples/lists/asserts, NAMED_GRAPH_NAMESPACE["DIFF_ADD"] -> namedgraph:DIFF_ADD in argument position

the function-local 'ex = Namespace("http://example.org/")' is absorbed by a function-body '@prefix ex: <http://example.org/> .' on the same line: the lexical block scope of @prefix matches the scope of the variable it replaces exactly

Literal("v1") is NOT rewritten: outside a g{} island a bare "v1" is a Python str, and "v1"^^xsd:string would be a different rdflib term, so plain literals in Python tuples stay Literal(...). This is the one construct the notation cannot absorb here
the data flow is unchanged: the triples stay Python tuples in a list, not a g{...} graph, because _add_triples takes an iterable of triples and the original builds no graph

the mechanical draft named the prefix after the Python constant ('named-graph-namespace:'); a hyphen is legal in a Turtle prefix but is silently NOT recognised in expression position (the transpiler leaves 'a-b:x' as-is, producing invalid Python), so it was renamed 'namedgraph:'
imports: RDF, Namespace and URIRef dropped (absorbed by the declarations), NAMED_GRAPH_NAMESPACE dropped (absorbed by @prefix namedgraph:); Literal kept because it is still needed

context shim: cognite.neat is not installed; cognite_neat_shim.py (shared verbatim with the sibling region test_diff_clears_previous_results) provides NAMED_GRAPH_NAMESPACE and a NeatInstanceStore reduced to __init__/from_oxi_local_store/graph/named_graphs/_add_triples/diff with the upstream bodies. from_oxi_local_store falls back to an in-memory rdflib Dataset because oxrdflib is absent; the named-graph diff behaviour under test is store-independent. Identical for both sides
the four assertions pass on both sides, so equivalence also means the rewritten terms are the ones the store actually stores and retrieves
